levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن نوفل

notes: «قرأت على مالك» names مالك as the teacher of يحيى, as in the other Muslim chains with «قرأت»
the saying is Umm Salama's own account: the Prophet's words are inside it and are not a link
HKG and RWY name further transmitters: the text ends at أم سلمة, so nothing is added
